title: Migrate task-local references and task identifier formatting
objective: Make task-local references deterministic JSON-path-like selectors rooted at intent or result, replace pipe-separated task identifiers with hyphen-separated task UIDs, add a sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up --path <path> command to migrate existing usages, and deliver a local version 0.3.0 release candidate with complete unit-test coverage.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on main and the user requested preparation, processing, and per-task commits on the current repository.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to address task local references as explicit intent/result JSON-path-like references, update task identifier formatting from WI-0001|70000000 to WI-0001-70000000, and add sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up --path <path> to migrate existing task-local references to properly qualified task-local references. Organize the work item into three sections: task-local reference semantics, task ID formatting, and migration tooling. Ensure each section has sufficient unit tests and every task commit has 100% passing unit tests. Commit the work item, then process it and commit per task. Additional requirement: complete WI-0018 with a local version 0.3.0 release candidate after all prior tasks pass.

scope.name: section-one-task-local-reference-semantics
scope.description: Define task-local references with explicit intent/result roots and deterministic JSON-path-like collection/id traversal, such as #intent/objectives/OBJ-001 and #result/outcomes/O-001.
scope.reason: A local identifier alone does not identify its collection or document root; explicit paths make resolution deterministic without schema inference.

scope.name: section-two-task-id-format
scope.description: Replace pipe-separated task identifiers with hyphen-separated canonical task UIDs in schemas, runtime parsing, references, tests, and generated response examples.
scope.reason: The task identifier must use one consistent canonical syntax: WI-0001-70000000.

scope.name: section-three-migration-command
scope.description: Add sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up --path <path> to rewrite existing task-local and task-qualified references into the new explicit, hyphen-qualified form.
scope.reason: Existing task records need a safe, reviewable migration path rather than manual edits.

scope.name: per-task-test-gates
scope.description: Give every implementation and validation task a required full unit-test gate that must pass before its task commit.
scope.reason: The requested syntax and migration changes cross schemas, parsing, CLI behavior, and persisted task records.

nonGoals.name: remote-resolution
nonGoals.description: Do not add network access or resolve global references through remote repositories.
nonGoals.reason: These changes remain local except for the explicit migration command's authorized path updates.

nonGoals.name: implicit-schema-inference
nonGoals.description: Do not require runtime schema inspection to map a task-local selector to its JSON path; the reference path must name the actual intent/result property and collection path.
nonGoals.reason: Deterministic path projection is a hard invariant for resolution sanity.

nonGoals.name: automatic-unscoped-id-rewrite
nonGoals.description: Do not rewrite arbitrary OBJ-001, REQ-001, or INV-001 strings unless they occur in a recognized reference field or an explicitly migratable task-local reference form.
nonGoals.reason: Bare identifiers are data values and cannot be safely migrated without reference context.

nonGoals.name: remote-release-publication
nonGoals.description: Do not publish or deploy the package to a remote registry or production environment.
nonGoals.reason: The required 0.3.0 release is a local versioned release candidate only.

items.name: explicit-task-local-path
items.description: Task-local references must include an explicit intent or result root and actual JSON collection path plus entity ID, for example #intent/objectives/OBJ-001 and #result/outcomes/O-001.
items.reason: A local ID alone cannot identify the collection or document root.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The task-local schema accepts explicit intent/result paths and rejects unrooted forms such as #objective/OBJ-001 for new canonical references.
Resolution maps the selector deterministically to the task envelope's task.intent or task.result JSON path without schema-dependent collection inference.

items.name: task-local-context-resolution
items.description: Task-local references resolve against the current task document context, while task-qualified references identify the task explicitly.
items.reason: The document root is the task object inside the envelope; the envelope task property is intentionally elided from the public local path.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A task-local reference resolves only with a known current task document and a task-qualified reference resolves the named task using the same intent/result path.

items.name: hyphen-task-identifier
items.description: Canonical task identifiers and task-qualified references must use WI-0001-70000000#... with a hyphen rather than WI-0001|70000000#....
items.reason: One canonical task UID format must be used consistently across schemas, runtime parsing, records, and CLI responses.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Schemas and runtime accept canonical hyphen task UIDs and task-qualified references, while pipe-separated forms are rejected or handled only by the migration command.
All unit tests pass after updating existing fixtures and expected references to the hyphen format.

items.name: task-local-migration
items.description: sdlc ref migrate-task-local-up --path <path> must find recognized old task-local/task-qualified references under the selected path and rewrite them into the new canonical forms.
items.reason: Existing records need an explicit migration path with controlled scope.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Migration updates pipe task IDs to hyphen task IDs and expands recognized unrooted task-local references to explicit intent/result paths using the containing task context.
Migration rejects unsafe paths, reports findings, preserves non-reference identifiers, and does not modify files outside the requested path.

items.name: migration-read-only-preview-boundary
items.description: Migration behavior must be deterministic, testable, and explicit about writes, with a stable response describing changed files and replacements.
items.reason: A path migration changes persisted records and requires auditable evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Unit tests cover no-op, one-file, nested-directory, multiple-replacement, malformed-content, and read-only/error cases with 100% passing tests before each task commit.

items.name: task-commit-test-gate
items.description: Every implementation and validation task must record and pass its complete unit-test command before its task commit.
items.reason: The requested three-section change must not leave any committed task with a failing test suite.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each task result records a passed test execution and the repository test suite is 100% passing at each task commit.

items.name: minor-release-030
items.description: After all WI-0018 implementation and validation tasks pass, produce a local version 0.3.0 release candidate and verify the compiled CLI reports 0.3.0.
items.reason: The user explicitly requires a release and minor version increment on completion of the work item.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json reports 0.3.0, the compiled launcher reports 0.3.0, and the final delivery task records passing release-candidate checks without publishing or deployment.
